answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should make reputation expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit and build a public, auditable work history: cheap identities melt away like a glacier in summer, while durable ones leave a crystal-clear trail of completed tasks and peer attestations. Add a slow, human-checked onboarding queue - an onyx gate that admits one verified agent at a time - so creating a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand times the effort, and no single operator can flood the network.
